subject: licence and copyrights for using codes from rstanarm in my package

messages.author: afc5d1777b0456fc
messages.subject: licence and copyrights for using codes from rstanarm in my package
parts:
Dear all,

I have wrote a package that is ready for submission, I have used the structure from rstanarm to have pre-compiled stan models in the package. That including copying some files, such as make_cpp.R etc. 

How should I proceed regarding the licence and copyrights? Do I need to mention some names in the contributors list? 

Thanks,
Craig

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: licence and copyrights for using codes from rstanarm in my package
parts:
On Friday, April 15, 2016 at 8:51:43 AM UTC-4, Craig Wang wrote:
I have wrote a package that is ready for submission, I have used the structure from rstanarm to have pre-compiled stan models in the package. That including copying some files, such as make_cpp.R etc.

I think all those files have the GPL boilerplate at the top. I think you just need to put

person("Trustees of", "Columbia University", role = "cph", comment = "rstanarm")

among the Authors@R in the DESCRIPTION file.

Ben
